about: The rules of spec/engine/weapons.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: spec/probes/weapons.py on the game copy, 2026-11-22: 359 SoldierWeaponData and 359 SoldierWeaponAsset, 280 SoldierAimingSimulationData, 574 ZoomLevelData, 180 WeaponFiringData and 180 FiringFunctionData, 117 BulletEntityData, 77 GunSwayData in 1,130 partitions; every weapon's WeaponFiring and PrimaryFire resolve (359 of 359), its projectile on 358

rules.title: Weapon, firing, projectile, sway, aiming

evidence.ref: spec/probes/weapons.py on the game copy, 2026-11-22: 321 players' weapons by WeaponClass as listed; AnimBaseSet wabsHg on 10 player firearms (wcSmg 9, wcAssault 1), all fltSingleFire

rules.title: WeaponClass, and no pistol class

rules.title: Body sets per class

evidence.ref: spec/probes/weapons.py on the game copy, 2026-11-22: 351 weapon partitions have a Package and a Dist copy, 325 of them differ (XML form); 159 firing partitions: 130 have Package copies, each name 1 content over all its Package copies; 93 of the 159 have 2 contents over all copies; of 68 distinct player firings with both copies, the Package one changes the falloff start on assault 8 of 10, SMG 12 of 13, LMG 7 of 7, shotgun 11 of 14 (falloff end 13 of 14); end damage and both falloff distances on sniper 5 of 8; the damage on the power tool 1 of 1

rules.title: DICE's balance patches are Package copies
Readers take the Package copy first

evidence.ref: spec/probes/weapons.py on the game copy, 2026-11-22: StartDamage / EndDamage / falloff distances on every BulletEntityData a player weapon fires (293 weapons over 85 partitions); 72 of them name an Explosion

rules.title: Damage lives on the projectile

evidence.ref: the fields name two end points and every stock profile is monotonic; the interpolation is not read from BFBC2Game.exe and was not measured in game

rules.title: Falloff between the two distances is linear

evidence.ref: spec/probes/weapons.py on the game copy, 2026-11-22: the damage-profile section, 98 distinct player firearm firings; NumberOfBulletsPerShell 12 on 10 and 6 on 5 shotgun weapons, 1 on the other 212 player firearms

rules.title: Damage profiles per class

rules.title: Every player firearm drops at -9.81

rules.title: Explosive projectiles

evidence.ref: DICE changed Shot.InitialSpeed (to 600) on every BF1943 firearm it converted and left the bullet's own field; the M24's 2000 on the bullet would make every sniper hit near-instant, which the game's sniper bullet drop contradicts; not read from BFBC2Game.exe

rules.title: Which of the two speeds flies the bullet
